description: Return the design decisions, rationale, invariants and gotchas recorded against a code anchor — the non-derivable engineering "why" a parser cannot recover from source. The anchor is a SCIP-style symbol string ("pkg/namespace/symbol") or a file path ("repo/path/file.ts"). Pass asOf to recall what was known at a past instant (bitemporal). Returns found:0 with empty memory when nothing is recorded.

asOf.description: Bitemporal cursor — recall what was known as of this instant

symbol.description: Code anchor — SCIP-style symbol or file path

userId.description: Per-user memory scope: tenant-global decisions plus this user's own; omit for tenant-global only

name: why
title: Recall the recorded "why" behind a code symbol
